original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import sa_lp_exact as M

def construct_packing():
    centers, radii, score = M.exact_sa(budget_sec=720.0, seed=20251021)
    # validity
    assert centers.shape == (26,2)
    assert radii.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(radii > 0)
    x, y = centers[:,0], centers[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(radii <= b + 1e-9)
    return centers, radii
